items.quote: Kindly transfer the total within 21 days of the date of this invoice, quoting the invoice number.
items.computation: Period start is the invoice date, 21 November 2026 (the day of the event is not counted, §187 Abs. 1 BGB). Counting 21 days from 21 Nov 2026: 21 Nov + 21 days = 12 December 2026. 12 December 2026 is a Saturday (24 Nov 2026 is a Tuesday, so 21 Nov is a Saturday, and Saturdays recur weekly: 21, 28 Nov, 5, 12 Dec). Since the last day is a Saturday, the deadline moves to the next working day under §193 BGB: Monday, 14 December 2026. No public holiday falls in between.
